meta_description: Gatenby Locksmiths Ltd in Leeds provides fast emergency lockout solutions, lock repairs and replacements. Available 24/7. Call us now.
hero_eyebrow: 24/7 Emergency Locksmith — Rapid Response in Leeds
hero_subhead: Gatenby Locksmiths arrives fast across Leeds. No call-out charge on emergency jobs.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to lock upgrades and key cutting, we cover all your security needs.

services.title: Emergency Lockout
services.desc: Locked out of your home, flat or business? We'll get you back inside fast — usually within 30 minutes of your call, day or night. Non-destructive entry where possible.

services.title: Lock Repairs & Replacement
services.desc: Broken lock, worn cylinder, or stuck mechanism? We repair or replace domestic and commercial locks on the spot, using quality fittings built to last.

services.title: Key Cutting
services.desc: Need spare keys cut quickly? We cut standard, master and specialist keys while you wait, at our workshop or on-site.

services.title: Upselling Security
services.desc: Upgrade to anti-snap, anti-bump or BS3621-rated locks for better protection against burglary. We advise on the right grade for your property.

services.title: Safe Opening
services.desc: Lost the combination to your safe, or key broken inside? We open home and commercial safes without damaging them wherever possible.

services.title: Vehicle Lockouts & Key Issues
services.desc: Locked your keys in the car or motorbike? We unlock vehicles and can cut replacement keys for most makes and models.

about_pullquote: We answer the phone at midnight because that's when people need us most.
about_para_1: Gatenby Locksmiths has served Leeds for over 15 years. We started because too many people were being overcharged for simple jobs — or waiting hours for help in a crisis. Today, we pride ourselves on fair pricing, swift response times, and turning up when we say we will.
about_para_2: Our reputation in Leeds is built on trust. We're locals, we know the city, and we treat every job — whether a 2am lockout or a routine lock replacement — with the same care. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and referrals from neighbours and local businesses.

reviews.text: Locked myself out on a Sunday evening and was in a right panic. Called Gatenby and they were here in 25 minutes. Really friendly bloke, got me in without damaging anything, and the bill was reasonable. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had the lock on my shop door break mid-morning. Needed it sorted same day before closing time. They came out, replaced it, and even cut me a spare key. Professional and quick. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Sophie K.

reviews.text: Called them at half eleven at night after locking my keys in the house. No fuss, no extra charge for the time, just got me back in and explained what had happened. That's the kind of service you remember.
reviews.author: Mark P.
